text:
ellie_support: Customer (Acme Mobile) escalated — streaming sessions drop mid-stream when users switch from 5G -> hotel WiFi. They get partial JSON, then socket closed by peer. Happens ~30-45s after switch. Asking for triage and a billing hold for affected calls.

liz_customer_success: Thanks Ellie — customer provided client logs and a sample request. They say 12% of sessions in last 24h. They've paused retries to avoid duplicate charges.

harry_mobile: quick note — customer uses our JS SDK with EventSource polyfill in their PWA; observed on iOS Safari 16 and Android Chrome. They reported token refresh happening at 60s, but disconnects at ~40s after network flip.

dan_eng: can we get the request IDs / trace IDs for one of the failures? Need the server-side request log and connection close reason. Also any proxy between client and our edge?

ellie_support: attached trace ids: trace=acme-98321, acme-98322. Customer says they're behind a corporate proxy in hotel network for the repro. Provided client log excerpt: 

----- client.log -----
[2026-03-10T14:02:12.345Z] EVENT: open stream id=abc123
[2026-03-10T14:02:32.210Z] NETWORK: started switching to WIFI
[2026-03-10T14:02:52.678Z] SSE: partial-chunk: \"{\"choices\":...}\n
[2026-03-10T14:02:53.002Z] ERROR: ECONNRESET by peer
---------------------

nina_sre: server logs for trace acme-98321 show: downstream FIN from client followed by RST from intermediate proxy. No 5xx on our side. Edge logs: last activity at 14:02:52, then connection closed. Looks like mid-TCP reset.

dan_eng: sounds like carrier/proxy rebind or NAT timeout during the handoff. Two angles: client keepalive/OS-level TCP teardown and token TTL race. What's token TTL on that stream?

ellie_support: customer token TTL=120s. They said SDK refresh runs at 60s. But disconnects happen before TTL expires. They also said they disable streaming reconnects to avoid duplicate messages (client setting).

harry_mobile: I can reproduce locally with their polyfill: if I toggle network adapter, EventSource polyfill emits an 'error' and then socket closes. Reconnect disabled equals truncated output.

dan_eng: repro steps requested for ENG: 
1) Use curl with --http2 -N against the same endpoint (simulate SSE): 
``` 
curl -v -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' "https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?engine=chat-1&trace=acme-98321" 
```
2) While streaming, trigger local network switch (airplane mode or network disable). Observe whether TCP FIN/RST happens from client side and whether our edge attempts keepalive probes.

nina_sre: also please capture a tcpdump on the client side and the edge connection if possible. We want to see whether kernel sends FIN or NAT sends RST. If NAT rebind, you see new src port after handshake.

ellie_support: customer uploaded a small pcap. Extracted snippet shows client sends FIN then proxy issues RST back to server. Not our runtime dropping.

dan_eng: OK. Root cause likely abrupt client TCP close due to OS socket handling on adapter swap, or proxy injecting RST. Mitigations: 
- Recommend clients keep request-level reconnect enabled and implement idempotency/resume tokens so server can resume partial outputs.
- Short-term customer workaround: enable SDK auto-reconnect with resume token, or extend client keepalive socket settings if possible (TCP_KEEPINTVL).
- Server-side options: increase prefix caching TTL so resumed requests return cached prefix while client reconnects.

harry_mobile: For PWA using EventSource polyfill we can wire up a resume token flow: on reconnect, send ?resume_token={last_event_id} and server returns continuation. Customer is open to SDK change but wants quick workaround.

liz_customer_success: Customer also requested billing pause for affected calls during our triage window. They provided list of session ids. Can we escalate billing to waive partial charges for these?

dan_eng: I'll ask billing to review; from infra perspective we didn't return 5xx, but they were charged for consumed tokens up to the disconnect. Ops — any precedent on waiving these?

deploy-bot: scheduled a quick canary deploy to edge region eu-west-2 for a keepalive tweak at 16:00 UTC (no restart to runtime, just config rollout).

nina_sre: followups for action items: 
- ellie: request tcpdump + client SDK version + exact device models from customer.
- harry: prototype client resume example in JS polyfill and send snippet.
- dan: check whether we can expose resume_token header in the API and whether prefix cache TTL can be increased per-customer temporarily.
- liz: open billing case and place hold until triage completes.

ellie_support: will collect logs and update ticket. Customer appreciates the canary for keepalive. They asked if we can temporarily suggest they enable client-side reconnect as recommended.

harry_mobile: sharing quick JS example for resume header: 
```
// onmessage, stash lastEventId
fetch('/v1/streams?resume_token='+lastEventId, {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer ...'}})
```

ellie_support: noted. I'll push the guidance and ask customer to enable reconnects for the short term. Will attach tcpdump when they send it.

dan_eng: thanks team. We'll keep this thread updated. If we see proxy RSTs in more customers, we should add a KB about recommended client reconnection patterns for mobile handoffs.
